title: Evaluation Metrics Module
summary: This module provides a collection of metrics for evaluating language model responses, including both LLM-based auto-evaluation techniques for semantic understanding and traditional string/token-based comparison methods.

nodes.label: Calculate Semantic F1 Score
nodes.title: Semantic F1 Score
nodes.description: Computes the semantic F1 score between a prediction and ground truth using LLM-based precision and recall. It can operate in a standard or decompositional mode.

nodes.label: Evaluate Completeness & Groundedness
nodes.title: Completeness & Groundedness Metric
nodes.description: Combines individual scores for answer completeness and groundedness into a single metric, leveraging LLM-based modules for each assessment.

nodes.label: Define Semantic Recall & Precision
nodes.title: Semantic Recall/Precision Signature
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature that defines the inputs and outputs for an LLM to compute semantic recall and precision between a system response and ground truth.

nodes.label: Define Decompositional Semantic Recall & Precision
nodes.title: Decompositional Semantic Recall/Precision Signature
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature for LLM-based semantic recall and precision that involves enumerating key ideas from both ground truth and system response before discussing their overlap.

nodes.label: Define Answer Completeness
nodes.title: Answer Completeness Signature
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature for an LLM to estimate the completeness of a system's response against a ground truth, by identifying and comparing key ideas.

nodes.label: Define Answer Groundedness
nodes.title: Answer Groundedness Signature
nodes.description: A DSPy Signature for an LLM to estimate the groundedness of a system's response by evaluating how well its claims are supported by retrieved context.

nodes.label: Check Exact Answer Match
nodes.title: Exact Match Metric
nodes.description: Evaluates if a predicted answer exactly matches or achieves a minimum F1-score threshold against a ground truth answer or a list of possible answers.

nodes.label: Check Passage for Answers
nodes.title: Passage Contains Answers Metric
nodes.description: Determines if a given text passage contains any of the specified reference answers, after applying text normalization.

nodes.label: Calculate Token Precision
nodes.title: Token Precision Score
nodes.description: Computes the token-level precision of a predicted answer against a ground truth answer, after text normalization.

nodes.label: Calculate HotPotQA F1 Score
nodes.title: HotPotQA F1 Metric
nodes.description: Calculates the maximum HotPotQA-style F1 score between a prediction and a list of reference answers, with specific handling for 'yes', 'no', and 'noanswer' cases.

nodes.label: Check Answer-Passage Match
nodes.title: Answer-Passage Match Metric
nodes.description: Verifies if any passage within a provided context contains the reference answer(s), after text normalization.

groups.label: LLM-based Auto-Evaluation
groups.title: LLM-based Auto-Evaluation Metrics
groups.description: Metrics that leverage Language Models (LLMs) to perform nuanced evaluations of responses, such as semantic similarity, completeness, and groundedness.

groups.label: Traditional Metrics
groups.title: Traditional String/Token Metrics
groups.description: Rule-based or string/token matching metrics for evaluating responses, focusing on exact matches, F1 scores, and passage containment.
